column4: DESKTOP STARTING BOARD 954x621 - RE-READ LIVE 2026-09-14 and UNCHANGED, with three constants confirmed against the source rather than against themselves. Wheel Ellipse 201 9733:7002 is 446.05999755859375 across, which is the literal the diameter law is anchored on; centre readout Frame 1000004188 9736:11659 is 185.85833740234375, and READOUT_DIAMETER_RATIO in FortuneWheelPro.tsx is that pair written out. Payout strip Frame 1000004187 9733:7060 is 954x42 at y=567: five 179.6 chips on a 187.6 pitch, 12 + 5*179.6 + 4*8 + 12 = 954 exact, label box 40x19 = 14/19. History strip Frame 1000004080 9733:7071 is 954x30 at y=12: five 61x30 chips on a 73 pitch ending 12 from the right edge, label 34x16 = 12/16 - HISTORY_CHIP's width 61, height 30, gap 12 and fontSize 12, verbatim. Pointer Group 321 10249:14232 is 26.46x63 at x=464 (centre 477.23 against the board's 477). ONE DIVERGENCE RECORDED AND NOT FIXED: HISTORY_CHIP.mobileScale 0.8 was derived from the retired 347 cut (48.8 x 24, gap 7.24), and the rebuilt 375 cut 11923:23830 draws 48 x 22 on a 56 pitch - 48/61 = 0.7869 wide against 22/30 = 0.7333 tall with an 8px gap, so it is no longer one scalar. Moving it means moving the constant and its oracle fortuneWheelParity.test.ts in one deliberate change.

MOBILE BOARD - RE-MEASURED 2026-09-14 THROUGH ITS REBUILT PAGE INSTANCE 11923:23757. The board moved (375 x 410, not 347 x 410) but THE FINDING THIS ROW CARRIES SURVIVED THE REBUILD INTACT, which is the point of re-measuring it: the payout strip did NOT go full-bleed with the board. Frame 1000004187 11923:23758 is still 347 wide, now at x=14 inside the 375 board, still 38 tall, five 58.80953 chips on a 66.048 pitch with a 7.2381 gap - i.e. the desktop strip 9733:7061 (179.6 on 187.6, gap 8, height 42) times 347/383.25 on every scalar, exactly the relation verified on six independent values last pass. The wheel is a 256 ellipse centred at x=59 ((375-256)/2 = 59.5). NEW ON THIS CUT AND NOT YET BUILT TO: the tier strip Frame 1000004080 11923:23830 at y=12, 375 x 22, five 48x22 chips on a 56 pitch ending 16 from the right edge - see 9733-7000 for why 48x22 is not the desktop chip times 0.8. The widget was read at HEAD (43b21cd0's gradient fix) and built on, never reverted.
